description: This Java class 'TbDate' provides comprehensive date and time manipulation functionalities, including parsing, formatting, and timezone adjustments, with support for ISO and RFC 1123 formats. It is used within the Thingsboard project for date handling in scripting APIs.

classes.name: TbDate
classes.description: A utility class for advanced date and time operations, including parsing, formatting, timezone conversions, and date arithmetic.

methods.name: getInstant
methods.description: Returns the internal Instant representation of the date.

methods.name: getZonedDateTime
methods.description: Returns the ZonedDateTime of the internal Instant in UTC or specified timezone.

methods.name: getLocalDateTime
methods.description: Returns the LocalDateTime in system default timezone.

methods.name: getUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the LocalDateTime in UTC timezone.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Returns ISO 8601 string of the date.

methods.name: toUTCString
methods.description: Returns date string in UTC timezone.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string with optional format to milliseconds.

methods.name: parseInstant
methods.description: Internal method to parse string to Instant, handling ISO and RFC formats.
